theorems.name: Submission.dmcbrz_imrep_zero_local_point_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U B : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U 0) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U 0), R.Represents S → CompactlyContained B U → ∃ (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℤ) (x : ℕ → Euclid P), (∀ l < N, x l ∈ B) ∧ (∀ l < N, w l ≠ 0) ∧ (∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, ((w l).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ R.measure B ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U 0, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) ⊆ B → S ω = ∑ l ∈ Finset.range N, (w l : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 0) (x l) (fun i => i.elim0)
